messages:
Alyssa: FYI StratusCare onboarding — they want traffic pinned to us-east-2 and a proxy peering. Also flagged an early renewal convo for next quarter; customer concerned about unit costs, wants enablement + a cost walkthrough.
Mike_netops: got it. do we have their ASN/CIDRs? need to prep peering rules and egress ACLs.
Alyssa: sending details in a sec — they provided 3 source subnets and a proxy NAT IP. also requested a temporary throughput bump for their demo (week of 2026-04-12).
Jordan_se: quick q — what's their current rate limit? default tier is 60 req/min per route for them, right? can we bump to 300/min for the demo week and pin them to a dedicated route so KV cache warms?
Mike_netops: we can open egress to their peering CIDRs and create a pinned route. prefer ephemeral allowlist w/ 14d TTL and auto-revoke. share CIDRs + an ops contact and I'll schedule the change.
Alyssa: CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/26, 198.51.100.0/28, 192.0.2.0/29. Contact: ops@stratuscare.com. Demo window: 2026-04-12T08:00Z -> 2026-04-19T08:00Z. Renewal flag noted — they asked for a cost/throughput walkthrough before renewal.
Ramon_ops: +1 on ephemeral TTL. For renewal: mark as "needs enablement" and schedule a 1:1 with solutions next week. I can own the auto-revoke policy.
Kai_support: I'll prep a short post-demo feedback survey focusing on latency and error rates, and add a short enablement checklist for the CSM handoff.
Jordan_se: here's a suggested config to apply to the customer route (pasting so infra has a single source of truth):
```
route: /v1/generate/stratuscare
region_pin: us-east-2
route_mode: dedicated
rate_limit: 300/min
kv_cache: { warmup: true }
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.0/26
  - 198.51.100.0/28
  - 192.0.2.0/29
ephemeral_ttl_days: 14
auto_revoke_at: 2026-04-26T08:00Z
notes: "Demo window 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-19; enablement + cost walkthrough scheduled"
```
Mike_netops: I'll queue the peering rules once Alyssa confirms the contact and the demo window in writing. Ramon: can you approve the TTL & auto-revoke?
Ramon_ops: Approved. set auto-revoke on 2026-04-26T08:00Z and notify CS 24h before revoke.
deploy-bot: egress-rules: queued change for customer=stratuscare, change_id=ch_sc_20260412_01, status=queued
Alyssa: thanks — confirming with the customer now and will paste the signed window + contact here. tagging @Kai_support for post-demo survey follow-up :raised_hands:
Kai_support: thanks! will prep survey + enablement doc and follow up after the demo.
